issue.title: Command palette hides grouping-cycle on Artifacts panes that already bind o/O
issue.description:
REPRODUCTION
On the Patches, Stitches, or Files pane, o / O cycle the L0 grouping bucket (check_app_action already allows cycle_grouping_mode / cycle_grouping_mode_reverse whenever the active artifacts contract has PaneCapability.GROUPING). Opening the command palette on those panes does not offer "Cycle grouping mode" or "Cycle grouping mode (reverse)".

ROOT CAUSE
src/sase/ace/tui/commands/_app_metadata.py scopes both actions to AGENTS_ONLY:

    ("cycle_grouping_mode", "Cycle grouping mode", "Grouping", AGENTS_ONLY, ()),
    ("cycle_grouping_mode_reverse", "Cycle grouping mode (reverse)", "Grouping", AGENTS_ONLY, ()),

CL_AGENTS already exists in src/sase/ace/tui/commands/_tabs.py for artifacts+agents. Availability.py is already contract-correct; only the palette tab tuple is wrong.

IMPACT
Keybinding and help/footer/badge surfaces agree that grouping-cycle lives on every grouping-capable Artifacts pane. The palette is the odd one out. Predates and is independent of the grouping_cycle_back_to_o key swap (o/O vs B/I).

SCOPE
Change those two APP_COMMAND_META tab tuples from AGENTS_ONLY to CL_AGENTS (or equivalent). Add/adjust catalog tests so the palette lists the actions on Artifacts as well as Agents, and still hides them on AXE. Do not change keybindings or check_app_action.

OUT OF SCOPE
Beads and Plans have no grouping-mode data; the keys are a silent no-op there. Do not invent a grouping capability for those panes just to make the palette row appear.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-m5 — closed task that first documented the Patch-pane o / grouping-cycle collision. That collision is resolved (mark_pr_origin is bang-mode !o; grouping-cycle is app-level o/O). This bead is only the leftover palette tab-scope mismatch, not a keybinding collision.
